studies.normalization: official per-record mean of counts greater than 0.5; density is count divided by that mean at positions with count greater than 0.5
studies.eligibility: official valid-CDS loader plus strictly greater than 0.60 fraction of codons with count greater than 0.5

split.procedure: for each seed, reproduce official np.random.seed(seed) followed by one randint(0,1024) split seed; shuffle the sorted eligible source IDs with that split seed; first floor(n/10) are validation and the remainder train
split.target_use: all eligible target records are evaluated only after source-validation early stopping and ridge alpha selection are complete; no target epoch-wise evaluation, fitting, calibration or model selection

official_model.selection: source-validation global R2, identical to the official best-checkpoint rule

compatibility.description: Five NumPy ragged-array dtype replacements, one numeric-padding dtype replacement and one pack_padded_sequence lengths.cpu() compatibility replacement; the study-OOD wrapper changes splitting and removes target evaluation from training logs, not the neural architecture, loss, optimizer or source-validation checkpoint rule.

ridge_baseline.type: source-trained position-wise ridge on normalized density
ridge_baseline.features: 64 official codon one-hot features, 20 relative-position-bin one-hot features, one relative-position scalar and one natural-log transcript-length feature divided by 7
ridge_baseline.sample_weight: none, matching official position-wise regression weighting
ridge_baseline.selection: source-validation transcript-balanced MSE; first grid value breaks exact ties

evaluation.target: official normalized ribosome density; an occupancy proxy, not a direct physical elongation-rate measurement
evaluation.mask: official get_data_pack mask: first five and last four codons set to zero, followed by density greater than zero
primary_endpoints: RiboMIMO minus ridge transcript-balanced MSE; negative favors RiboMIMO
RiboMIMO minus ridge mean within-transcript Pearson; positive favors RiboMIMO
evaluation.secondary: global R2, global MSE, global Pearson, mean within-transcript Spearman, constant baseline and all three seed-specific results

permutation.test: two-sided paired sign-flip with plus-one correction

evaluation.multiplicity: Holm across exactly two primary endpoints
evaluation.target_pearson_rule: within-transcript correlation requires at least two masked positions and nonconstant target and prediction; all exclusions are reported

execution.independent_retrain: repeat all three seeds in a new artifact directory and compare every target prediction array and checkpoint tensor; separately recompute raw matrices, ridge predictions and statistics without importing the production module
execution.reason: the GPU is shared with unrelated processes, so wall time is recorded but is not a unified single-worker time-matched comparison

scientific_scope.prior_target_readout_boundary: Subtelny14 was previously evaluated for RiboKinetic and its ridge baseline; this protocol is frozen before any RiboMIMO target prediction, but is not represented as a globally untouched dataset.
